name: Update
description: Update rows in an existing database table using JSON values and required equality filters.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: Optional JSON object of updated column values. Overrides configured values when connected.

inputs.name: filters
inputs.description: Optional JSON object of equality filters. Overrides configured filters when connected.

controllers.name: connection
controllers.description: Database connection controller from a database node.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: JSON object of column names to updated values.

parameters.name: schema_name
parameters.description: Optional PostgreSQL schema. Ignored for SQLite.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Required JSON object of column names to equality filter values.

parameters.name: version_column
parameters.description: Optional version column used for optimistic concurrency.

parameters.name: expected_version
parameters.description: Expected version value when version_column is set.

parameters.name: increment_version
parameters.description: Increment the version column after a successful update.
